Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to successfully locate the link to the referenced paper within the article. Despite multiple instructions to scroll down and search for keywords like "link to the paper," "full paper," or "findings published," the agent only provided text snippets from the main body of the article (discussing filaments and black holes) and never actually found or opened the link at the bottom of the page. Because the specific paper containing the acknowledgment section with R. G. Arendt's NASA award number was never accessed, the subsequent final answer (80NSSC21K0223) was based on incorrect or guessed information rather than the required source material.
